instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. On a sandy beach with a rocky breakwater and hazy sea under an overcast sky, the woman in the peach crop top (R1) walks to the right in the left foreground, smiling slightly in profile with her hair blowing. Beside her, the man in the blue t-shirt and headband (R2) walks to the right in the right background, turning his head to look at her with a warm smile. They walk closely side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight with a warm, muted color palette.
